newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices steady to lower this week.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices steady to lower this week.

text.p: BANGKOK, Sept 20 (reuter) - Thai rubber prices were steady to lower this week in a quiet market, industry sources said on Friday.
Thai benchmark RSS3 for October shipment was quoted around US$1.26-1.29 this week, compared with US$1.28-1.29/kg last week.
Latex price was also steady at $1.02/kg, they said.
There were only few enquiries and high Japanese stocks continued to pressure the market, they said.

The actual amount of rubber entering the market this week would be known later on Friday. But rubber auction market sources said they did not expect the amount to be much different from last week when about 287,000 kg of rubber got into the market.
